title: Finitely presented modules over generalized valuation rings
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof finds a generator whose annihilator remains minimal for every lift of its residue class. It proves the cyclic submodule is relatively divisible by comparing totally ordered principal ideals, splits off that summand and inducts to obtain a cyclic decomposition.
